name: Metallic Dragonborn

traits.name: Metallic Breath Weapon
traits.description: Starting at character level 5, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one attack with a 15-foot cone of non-damaging Metallic Breath. Choose Enervating Breath or Repulsion Breath when used. Each creature in the area, including allies, makes the saving throw for the chosen effect against DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Constitution modifier. You can use either option once per Long Rest in total; this is a separate resource from ordinary Breath Weapon uses.

reviewNotes: The family is not selectable: select Brass, Bronze, Copper, Gold or Silver Dragonborn.

The ordinary damage Breath Weapon inherits its attack replacement, proficiency-bonus uses, Dexterity saving throw and damage progression from species.dragonborn; this family supplies its 15-foot cone.
Metallic Breath Weapon has one shared use for either option, independent of normal Breath Weapon uses.

Enervating Breath invokes the native Incapacitated condition, including ending Concentration, without implicitly removing movement, speech or awareness. Repulsion applies the native Prone condition and its native AC/movement effects.
Chromatic Warding versus Metallic Breath Weapon remains subject to comparative playtest balance. No universal Draconic Flight or Upbringing selection is granted.
